(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP/2025)
CLASS: BBA   SEMESTER : VI/ADD
BRANCH: BBA   SESSION : SP/2025

SUBJECT: MT319 INTEGRATED MARKETING COMMUNICATION
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   CO BL
Q.1 Describe the concept of IMC and with suitable examples explain how marketers have
used IMC to achieve promotion and marketing objectives more effectively.
[5] 2 3


Q.2 Briefly  explain  the  different  promotion  mix elements.  Detail  the  benefits  and
criticisms of Advertising.
[5] 1 2


Q.3 Briefly  explain  the  process  of  IMC  planning.  Why  is  it  important  to  evaluate  and
analyze the marketing plan before developing the IMC plan.
[5] 2 4


Q.4 How is the concept of communications objectives related to the DAGMAR concept.
Describe the characteristics of DAGMAR objectives and outline the major criticisms
to the concept.
[5] 3 2


Q.5(a) What is an advertising agency. [2] 4 1
Q.5(b) Describe the general flow of work in an advertising agency along the production and
creative sides.
[3] 4 1
